summary: Iter 146 backend: 8/8 tests PASSED. Validated (1) Smart Inbox payment flow — parse 'Venmo: You paid $150' yields kind='payment' with amount+method, POST /inbox/drafts/{id}/confirm with kind=payment+applied_expense_ids flips the targeted expense to paid=true (balance 0); (2) confirm-all auto-matches a payment draft to the best open expense; (3) regression — hotel text still yields kind='booking', receipt text yields kind='expense'; (4) GET /team/calendar/importable now returns past-dated and non-practice events (clinic/banquet/competition); (5) POST /team/calendar/import-from-personal {source:'schedule'} on a weekly series imports the whole series as ONE recurring team_event, re-import from another occurrence returns already=true; (6) {source:'competition'} with include:{hotel,flight,car} injects booking blurbs into team event notes AND a second call upserts (returns updated=true with the SAME event_id, not a duplicate). Frontend quick-check: Smart Inbox screen loads with testIDs inbox-paste, inbox-read, review-{id}, inbox-confirm; the authenticated UI flow was not fully exercised because the preview session didn't carry auth from supplied credentials (ingress returned 401 for API calls on unauth'd session). Backend contract fully confirms the new iteration works end-to-end.
action_items: Main agent: self-verify the two FRONTEND toggles — on /schedule/new and /competitions/new logged in as demo@cheerplanner.app the 'Add to TeamHub Calendar' switch should appear (team_access=true); on the competition form toggling it should reveal Hotel/Flight/Car/Teams-to-watch/Packing/Links checkboxes and saving should succeed. My automation couldn't fully drive the authenticated UI flow (login form not surfaced on root URL in the preview session), but backend endpoints that back these toggles are proven green.
(Nice-to-have) Add testIDs to the 'Add to TeamHub Calendar' switch and its include checkboxes on both /schedule/new and /competitions/new so future UI automation can click them deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/inbox.py confirm_draft(): kind='payment' calls routers.payments.create_payment which depends on require_visibility('expenses'). Confirmed working for the owner/demo account via tests. Just flag that users without expenses visibility would get an authorization error when confirming a payment draft — acceptable since payment creation already lives behind the same gate.

routers/team_calendar.py _import_from_personal_one(): competition branch now updates existing team_events in place (good — no duplicate on re-push). Note that this update rewrites 'notes', 'title', 'location', 'date', 'start_time', 'end_time' every time. If a staff member hand-edited the TeamHub event's notes after the initial import, those edits are overwritten by the next re-push. Consider gating the update behind a flag or only appending booking blocks that aren't already present.
